steps.note: Open the eRFX project creation flow.
Choose the RFQ template required before adding and filling line items.
Verify that an RFQ template is applied.
Complete the RFQ pricing sheet so the missing title is the only publish precondition being tested.
Set the requested plant as the line item's delivery location.
Verify the delivery location was retained.

Add the available QA test vendor so participants are not the reason publication is blocked.
Press Publish and verify publication is refused specifically because the project title is empty.
